full_prompt_en: A square pen-and-ink illustration with a muted blue-green wash shows three elderly men in the left foreground looking toward an elaborate structure across a shadowed open space. The background is filled with dark foliage, layered stone forms, and an ornate facade near the upper center. Small bright figures appear on and around its steps, reduced to delicate pale marks within the distant detail. Below them, the middle and lower right hold a dense pattern of irregular shapes and fine lines, suggesting a garden or patterned ground seen from above. The nearest man sits at the lower left in profile, facing right. His white hair, strong nose, and pointed white beard are rendered with fine hatching; his dark coat becomes a broad, nearly black anchor in the foreground. Just behind him, another bald-headed man leans toward the view, while a taller figure stands farther left with the back and side of his head visible. The figures overlap closely, their shoulders forming a diagonal passage from the upper left toward the seated man's face. A pale ledge or tabletop cuts diagonally across the lower foreground, separating their dark clothing from the more intricate area beyond. The scene has no clearly readable text. Diffuse light catches the pale heads, beard, distant architectural edges, and a few figures on the steps, while the blue-green wash settles into recesses and leafy shadow. Dense directional strokes give the stonework, foliage, and clothing varied texture without losing the main silhouettes. The overall composition places a quiet group of observers before a richly drawn, almost dreamlike distance, balancing warm paper highlights with cool deep ink.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅铺有低饱和蓝绿色淡彩的方形钢笔墨线插画呈现三位年长男子站坐在左侧前景，望向暗色开阔区域彼端的繁复建筑。后景充满深色枝叶、层叠石质形体，以及上部中央附近装饰繁多的立面。细小的明亮人影出现在台阶及其周围，在远景细节中缩为精巧的浅色笔痕。它们下方，画面中部和右下布满不规则形状与细线的密集图案，像从高处看到的园地或铺纹。最近的男子坐在左下角，以侧面朝右。白发、突出的鼻子与尖尖的白胡子由细密排线塑造；深色外套则成为前景一块近黑的宽大稳定形体。他身后另一位秃顶男子向景色探身，更靠左处还有一位较高人物，露出头部的背面和侧面。三人紧密重叠，肩膀从左上方向坐者的脸形成斜向引导。一道浅色栏沿或桌沿斜穿下部前景，将深色衣着与远处更繁密的区域分开。画面没有清楚可读的文字。漫射光照亮浅色头部、胡子、远处建筑的边缘及台阶上的少量人物，蓝绿色淡彩则积在凹处和叶影里。密集的方向性笔触赋予石材、枝叶和衣服不同肌理，同时保持主要剪影清楚。整体构图把安静的观者群放在丰富而近乎梦境般的远景之前，以暖纸色高光平衡冷调深墨。
style_prompt_en: The ink drawing uses exceptionally fine, repeated linear strokes to build broad tonal fields from small marks. Cool blue-green wash seeps through the hatchwork and darkens recessed areas, while exposed warm paper supplies the brightest notes. Forms emerge through changing line density: tight crosshatching gives weight to foreground masses, and lighter broken marks let distant detail recede. Organic irregularity and intricate constructed geometry coexist inside the same tonal atmosphere. Overlapping planes create depth without a hard photographic blur; even far areas remain delicately articulated. Edges are strongest around a few prominent silhouettes and loosen into clustered texture elsewhere. Diffuse illumination moves through the scene as small pale openings surrounded by blue-black shadow. The composition favors a dark near-side anchor, a diagonal ledge, and an elaborately detailed distance. The overall effect is contemplative, antique, and immersive, with patience in the mark-making as its defining visual feature.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墨线绘画用极细而反复的线性笔触，把小笔痕累积成宽阔的明暗区域。冷调蓝绿色淡彩渗入排线，并加深凹陷区域；露出的暖色纸面则提供最亮的重音。形体通过变化的线条密度浮现：紧密交叉排线赋予前方大形重量，较轻的破碎笔痕让远处细节后退。有机的不规则形与繁复的构造几何处于同一种明暗气氛中。重叠色面形成纵深，却不依赖强烈摄影式虚化；即使远处仍有精细刻画。边缘在少数主要剪影周围最强，在其他位置则松开为成簇肌理。漫射光以被蓝黑阴影包围的细小浅色开口穿过画面。构图偏好近处深色锚点、斜向分隔线和精细铺陈的远景。整体效果沉思、古雅且有沉浸感，耐心密集的笔痕是它最鲜明的视觉特征。
theme_en: Three elderly viewers overlooking an elaborate distant structure
theme_zh: 三位年长观者俯瞰远处繁复的建筑
name: Franklin Booth
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
